source: DHM Islamic Studies Level 2 · lesson 1. Exercises reused from the lesson.
topic: He made everything out of nothing

learn.en: Allah is the Creator. He made everything out of nothing: the sky, the earth, the sun, the moon and the stars.
learn.title: He made everything

learn.en: He made the plants, flowers of different colours, fish that swim, birds that fly, and every animal — elephants, lions, camels, cats!
learn.title: A wonderful world

learn.en: When Allah wants something, He just says to it “Be!” — and it is.
learn.title: “Be!” and it is

learn.en: Only Allah can create. Nobody else can create as Allah creates — not even a fly or a mosquito!
learn.title: Only Allah can create

learn.en: So we thank Him for all His gifts and say: Al-hamdu lillāhi Rabbil-ʿālamīn.
learn.title: Thank You, Allah

learn.en: “Allah is the Creator of all things, and He is, over all things, Disposer of affairs.” (Qur'an 39:62)
learn.title: From the Qur'an

words.en: Praise be to Allah, Lord of all the worlds

quiz.en: What did Allah make everything out of?
Who can create as Allah creates?
True or false? Allah is One; there is no one equal to Him.
True or false? People can create a fly if they try hard.

think.q: Look out of the window. Name three things Allah created that you can see right now.
think.a: The sky, trees, birds… everything is from Allah — Al-ḥamdu lillāh!

parents.summary: Allah is the Creator: He made everything out of nothing, and only He can create. We thank Him: al-ḥamdu lillāhi Rabbi l-ʿālamīn.
parents.tip: On a walk, take turns naming things Allah created.
